programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeYear: 2026-28 (fee table for batch admitted 2026; 2027-29 not separately published)
programs.feeNote: Derived total of non-residential academic charges for the batch admitted in 2026 (AY 2026-27 fee table in the Admissions 2027 Information Booklet; subject to revision): tuition Rs 6,40,000 x 2 years = 12,80,000 + examination fee 11,000 x 2 = 22,000 + registration 1,000 + eligibility 1,000 + alumni 3,500 + convocation 2,500 + placement registration 7,000 = Rs 13,17,000. Excludes refundable security deposit 13,000, hostel (Rs 90,000-1,80,000 per year for 10 months depending on room; base non-AC twin Rs 99,000 + GST), mess approx. 58,800/yr, student activity advance 8,000/yr, learning-material advance 8,000/yr, laundry 6,250/yr. NRI tuition US$ 15,000/yr.
programs.intakeNote: Admissions 2027: 300 seats = 180 General (institute) + 45 NRI/NRI-sponsored + 75 ACPC Gujarat state quota (excluding EWS), plus 15% supernumerary for PIO/FN/CIWGC-SEA. ACPC's CoE list for 2026-27 also shows total intake 300 (94 via ACPC incl. EWS).
programs.placementNote: Official Nirma Placement Report 2024-25 gives only specialisation-wise average CTC (Finance 11.50 LPA, Marketing 11.30 LPA, HR 11.10 LPA; highest 20.00/20.00/70.00 LPA) for a pool that combines MBA FT and B.Tech-MBA (602 students); no batch-wide average or median published, so salary fields are null.

programs.name: Master of Business Administration - Human Resource Management (MBA-HRM)
programs.feeYear: 2026-28 (fee table for batch admitted 2026; 2027-29 not separately published)
programs.feeNote: Same fee table as MBA (booklet lists a common 'MBA and MBA(HRM) Programme Fee Structure'). Derived total of non-residential academic charges for the batch admitted in 2026 (AY 2026-27 fee table in the Admissions 2027 Information Booklet; subject to revision): tuition Rs 6,40,000 x 2 years = 12,80,000 + examination fee 11,000 x 2 = 22,000 + registration 1,000 + eligibility 1,000 + alumni 3,500 + convocation 2,500 + placement registration 7,000 = Rs 13,17,000. Excludes refundable security deposit 13,000, hostel (Rs 90,000-1,80,000 per year for 10 months depending on room; base non-AC twin Rs 99,000 + GST), mess approx. 58,800/yr, student activity advance 8,000/yr, learning-material advance 8,000/yr, laundry 6,250/yr. NRI tuition US$ 15,000/yr.
programs.intakeNote: Admissions 2027: 30 seats = 18 General + 5 NRI/NRI-sponsored + 7 ACPC state quota.
programs.placementNote: No programme-level average/median published (HR specialisation average 11.10 LPA in the 2024-25 report covers the combined pool).

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on CAT 2026 score
selectionProcess.detail: Apply separately to Nirma (application fee Rs 1,600; NRI Rs 4,500). Gujarat candidates may also apply via ACPC for state-quota seats.

selectionProcess.name: Personal Interview and Theme Development & Presentation (TDP)
Composite merit
selectionProcess.weightage: CAT 60%, PI 20%, TDP 10%, Academic performance 10% (+ up to 10 points for relevant full-time work experience)
selectionProcess.detail: Academic performance = pre-final graduation 50%, Class XII 30%, Class X 20%.

selectionWeightage.note: Admissions 2027 composite score; additional up to 10 points for relevant full-time work experience.

keyDates.notes: Application opened 14 Sep 2026; last date '3rd week of December 2026'; shortlisting 4th week Jan 2027; PI/TDP 1st week Feb 2027; offers 4th week Feb / 1st week Mar 2027; programme starts 3rd week of June 2027. CAT 2026 on 29 Nov 2026.

nirf.note: Ranked entity is Nirma University (the university), not the Institute of Management alone.
